bias.label: Leaning up while above 4,135; new day high 4,149 before CPI

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Late push higher
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,143 at 23:31 SAST, up about 73 (1.8%) on the day (Kitco).

bullets.title: Above 4,135
bullets.text: Gold broke this morning's 4,135 high and set a new day high of 4,149, with a day range of 4,053-4,149 (Kitco).

bullets.title: Dollar weaker
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 101.7, down about 0.6% on the day, which supports gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Oil eases inflation
bullets.text: Falling oil has eased inflation worries and helped gold to its best level since 21 October (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Hike odds high
bullets.text: Markets still price about an 81% chance of a Fed hike in December, which can cap the rally (Trading Economics, CME FedWatch).

bullets.title: China still buying
bullets.text: China's central bank bought about 25.8 tonnes of gold in October (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: CPI tomorrow
bullets.text: October CPI lands Tue 15:30 SAST; a hot number can drag gold back under 4,135, a soft one can open 4,200 (Discovery Alert, MoneySafe).
